def region_counts_and_feats(g, sep):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(c for r in g for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if all(c==sep for c in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(H))]
    rb=runs(H,set(rows)); cb=runs(W,set(cols))
    R=len(rb); C=len(cb)
    marks=[[[(i-rr[0],j-cc[0]) for i in rr for j in cc if g[i][j] not in (0,sep,bg)] for cc in cb] for rr in rb]
    return marks, R, C, bg, rb, cb, H, W

def feats(m, ri, ci, allm, R, C, rb, cb, H, W):
    f={}
    n=len(m)
    f['n2']= n==2
    f['n1']= n==1
    f['n_ge2']= n>=2
    cols_={}; rows_={}
    for i,j in m: cols_.setdefault(j,[]).append(i); rows_.setdefault(i,[]).append(j)
    f['vpair']=any(len(v)>=2 for v in cols_.values())
    f['hpair']=any(len(v)>=2 for v in rows_.values())
    f['vgap']=any(b-a>1 for v in cols_.values() for a,b in zip(v,v[1:]))
    f['hgap']=any(b-a>1 for v in rows_.values() for a,b in zip(v,v[1:]))
    f['adj_pair']=any(abs(a-b)==1 for v in cols_.values() for a,b in zip(v,v[1:])) or any(abs(a-b)==1 for v in rows_.values() for a,b in zip(v,v[1:]))
    f['diag']=any(abs(i1-i2)==abs(j1-j2) for i1,j1 in m for i2,j2 in m if (i1,j1)!=(i2,j2))
    f['edge']=any(i in (0,len(rb[ri])-1) or j in (0,len(cb[ci])-1) for i,j in m)
    f['corner']=any(i in (0,len(rb[ri])-1) and j in (0,len(cb[ci])-1) for i,j in m)
    # cross-region
    cnts=[[len(x) for x in row] for row in allm]
    f['rowmax']= n==max(cnts[ri]) and n>0
    f['colmax']= n==max(cnts[r][ci] for r in range(R)) and n>0
    f['rowmax_unique']= n==max(cnts[ri]) and cnts[ri].count(n)==1
    f['colmax_unique']= n==max(cnts[r][ci] for r in range(R)) and [cnts[r][ci] for r in range(R)].count(n)==1
    f['row_unique_cnt']= cnts[ri].count(n)==1
    f['col_unique_cnt']= [cnts[r][ci] for r in range(R)].count(n)==1
    f['n_odd']= n%2==1
    f['n_even']= n%2==0
    return f

def pair_feats(ms, rh, rw):
    f={}
    n=len(ms)
    f['n2']=n==2
    f['n1']=n==1
    if n!=2:
        for k in ['vert','horiz','unal','gap0','vgap','hgap','span_half','span_half_strict','col_edge','row_edge','same_col_last','same_row_last','centered','dist_ge2']:
            f[k]=False
        return f
    (a,b)=ms
    vert = a[1]==b[1]; horiz=a[0]==b[0]; unal=not vert and not horiz
    f['vert']=vert; f['horiz']=horiz; f['unal']=unal
    d=abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])
    f['gap0']=d==1; f['dist_ge2']=d>=2
    f['vgap']=vert and d>=2
    f['hgap']=horiz and d>=2
    rs=abs(a[0]-b[0])+1; cs=abs(a[1]-b[1])+1
    f['span_half']= (vert and rs*2>rh) or (horiz and cs*2>rw) or (unal and (rs*2>rh or cs*2>rw))

    f['centered']= vert and min(a[0],b[0])<= (rh-1)/2 <= max(a[0],b[0]) and a[1]==(rw-1)//2
